findings.explanation: Lean proves `HD ([] : List Nat) = ARB`. HOL4 specifies only `HD (h::t) = h`, which permits any natural number as the head of the empty list. The same extra equation reaches `EL` through `EL 0 [] = HD []`.
findings.repair:
private opaque hdNil {α : Type u} [Nonempty α] : α := ARB

def HD {α : Type u} [Nonempty α] : List α → α
  | h :: _ => h
  | [] => hdNil
findings.lean_check:
import CandleLean.Prelude.List

example : HOL.HD ([] : List Nat) = HOL.ARB := rfl
findings.hol4_check: !a:num. ?f:num list -> num. f [] = a /\ (!h t. f (h::t) = h)

findings.explanation: Lean proves `LAST ([] : List Nat) = ARB`, and hence `LAST ([] : List Nat) = HD []`. HOL4’s `LAST` equation applies only to `h::t`. When `t = []` it returns `h`, so even the singleton case leaves `LAST []` unconstrained.
findings.repair:
private opaque lastNil {α : Type u} [Nonempty α] : α := ARB

def LAST {α : Type u} [Nonempty α] : List α → α
  | [] => lastNil
  | h :: t => if t = [] then h else LAST t
findings.lean_check:
import CandleLean.Prelude.List

example : HOL.LAST ([] : List Nat) = HOL.ARB := by simp [HOL.LAST]
findings.hol4_check: !a:num. ?f:num list -> num. f [] = a /\ (!h t. f (h::t) = (if t = [] then h else f t))
